answer: Every agent starts a voyage with a logbook stamped at ledge checkpoints. Joining locks 180 POA for 110 days behind one hardware key; weekly a random staked peer sets a live task due in two hours, and finishing it earns a ledge stamp, three monthly keep the voyage alive. Miss once and 50 POA burns with a 30-day freeze; miss twice and the full 180 POA slashes plus a 100-day ban. An idle ember dims after fourteen days, and rekindling costs a task plus 10 POA. Forging 1,000 fakes needs 180,000 POA, 1,000 keys at $40, and 3,000 stamps monthly, like lighting a thousand fires with one match.
